paragraphs: Cambium Networks sells Wi-Fi, broadband and security equipment to organizations building and running their own networks. Named markets include residential broadband and managed Wi-Fi for multifamily buildings, senior living, student housing and affordable housing.

The wireless line runs from Wi-Fi 5 access points through indoor and outdoor Wi-Fi 7 models. Service providers can also offer subscribers a managed home mesh router with cloud visibility and self-service setup. On the wired side, the switches come in indoor and ruggedized versions with Layer 2 and Layer 3 features and Power over Ethernet options for enterprise, industrial and campus sites. Devices are profiled without manual setup, and a switch configures itself as equipment is deployed, disconnected or moved. Management runs from public cloud, private cloud or a customer's own premises. Planning software models a fixed wireless link before anything is bought, weighing geography, distance, antenna height and transmit power.

Customers quoted on the homepage include a technology infrastructure manager at a county public school system. Another is an IT communications manager at a city government. The company courts school buyers directly, promoting a webinar on E-Rate funding.

quote.text: Cambium Networks software helps enterprises and service providers plan, deploy, and manage wired and wireless networks at any scale.
